items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Alipay, UnionPay, credit card and cryptocurrencies such as USDT. Your plan is active right after purchase.

For a first purchase, you can request a refund within 7 days if you've used no more than 1 GB of data. The refund goes to your account wallet balance, which you can use to renew or withdraw to a crypto wallet.

items.q: How many devices can one account use?
items.a: The App Edition allows 5 devices online at once; the Router Edition supports unlimited devices connected to the router.
items.aAppOnly: The App Edition allows 5 devices online at once per account.

items.q: App Edition or Router Edition — which should I choose?
items.a: If it's just your own phone and computer, choose the App Edition. If you have TVs, game consoles or smart speakers at home that need it too, or you don't want to install software device by device, choose the Router Edition. You can have both.

items.q: When does Router Edition service start?
items.a: One year counted from the day your router ships. The wait between payment and shipping doesn't count against your service period.
